Critical Mass Houston

Houston, TX · East End

Critical Mass Houston is a social group ride in Houston, TX. It meets last Friday of every month. Gather 6:45–7:15 pm, roll 7:15 pm, starting at Guadalupe Plaza Park. Pace: slow, all skill levels.

About the Critical Mass Houston group ride

A casual monthly ride from Guadalupe Plaza Park east of downtown, going wherever, ending somewhere fun around 9:30 or 10. Rain or shine. Bring lights and a helmet.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
